name: gmail-to-calendar
description: Automated Gmail to Google Calendar sync web application

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "server,client" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run build:server
scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev && npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev
